controls.title: Establish Governance Policies
controls.description: Establish AI risk management governance policies, including organizational roles and alignment with risk appetite.

controls.title: Map AI Context & Risks
controls.description: Map the AI system context, specify business goals, and categorize risks and potential negative impacts.

controls.title: Measure Trustworthiness & Robustness
controls.description: Measure AI system trustworthiness, bias, robustness, and accuracy against standards before and during deployment.

controls.title: Manage Operational Risks & Drift
controls.description: Manage risks of active systems, establish incident reporting pathways, and continuous validation pipelines.

controls.title: Principles of Processing & Minimisation
controls.description: Enforce data minimization, purpose limitation, and storage limitation constraints across AI inference pipelines.

controls.title: Lawfulness of Processing & Consent
controls.description: Verify and log lawful basis or valid consent before user personal data is ingested for model reasoning or training.

controls.title: Automated Erasure in Vector Memory
controls.description: Operationalize automated erasure pipelines to purge data subject embeddings from agent vector memory upon revocation.

controls.title: Automated Decision Protections
controls.description: Enforce safeguards against automated profiling and decisions without explicit human review mechanisms.

controls.title: Security of Processing & Pseudonymisation
controls.description: Enforce pseudonymisation and cryptographic protection of personal data payloads across AI agent tool invocations.

controls.title: Grounds for Processing Personal Data
controls.description: Process digital personal data strictly in accordance with statutory grounds, valid consent, or legitimate uses.

controls.title: Notice & Purpose Limitation
controls.description: Provide itemized consent notices detailing categories of personal data processed by AI systems and specified purposes.

controls.title: Reasonable Security Safeguards
controls.description: Take reasonable technical safeguards and security measures to prevent personal data breaches in connected services.

controls.title: Right to Correction & Erasure
controls.description: Provide accessible mechanisms for Data Principals to request correction, completion, and permanent erasure of records.

controls.title: Security Management & Risk Analysis
controls.description: Conduct thorough assessments of risks and vulnerabilities to electronic protected health information (ePHI) in AI workloads.

controls.title: Access Controls & Model Token Isolation
controls.description: Implement technical access controls restricting ePHI database queries and prompt injection to authorized agents.

controls.title: Audit Controls & ePHI Telemetry Logging
controls.description: Deploy immutable audit logging recording every agent interaction, database query, and prompt touching ePHI.

controls.title: Minimum Necessary PHI Disclosure
controls.description: Enforce automated masking filters ensuring only the minimum necessary PHI is exposed during model inference.

controls.title: Primary Account Number (PAN) Encryption
controls.description: Render PAN unreadable anywhere stored, including agent vector stores, execution logs, and temporary caches.

controls.title: Cardholder Data Access Restriction
controls.description: Restrict access to cardholder environments and token stores strictly to authorized system processes and agents.

controls.title: Automated Cardholder Audit Trails
controls.description: Maintain automated audit logs tracking all administrative actions and agent queries involving cardholder data.

obligations.article_or_task: NIST RMF GOV-1.2 — Define Authority Matrices
obligations.description: Formally define the roles, responsibilities, and authorization levels for all AI builders, risk managers, and auditors.
Document the intended business goals, operational environment, and specific problem the AI system aims to solve.

obligations.article_or_task: NIST RMF MEASURE-2.3 — Prompt Injection Threat Model
obligations.description: Run recurring red-teaming simulations evaluating model vulnerabilities to jailbreaks, prompt injections, and data extraction.

obligations.article_or_task: NIST RMF MANAGE-1.2 — Performance Drift Alerting
obligations.description: Configure automated monitors tracking model semantic shift and output distribution drift over time.
Review model prompts and vector embeddings to verify no unnecessary PII fields are persisted.

obligations.article_or_task: GDPR Art. 6 — Lawful Processing Basis Verification
obligations.description: Document and verify consent records or contract execution legal grounds for each AI data pipeline.

obligations.article_or_task: GDPR Art. 17 — Vector Embedding Erasure Hook
obligations.description: Deploy automated deletion triggers to expunge data subject records from vector indexes upon user request.

obligations.article_or_task: GDPR Art. 22 — Human Intervention in Profiling
obligations.description: Provide an accessible mechanism letting users contest automated profiling decisions and request manual review.
Enforce AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit for all external LLM API traffic.
Conduct quarterly audits verifying that personal data ingested by models matches registered legitimate uses.

obligations.article_or_task: DPDP Sec. 6 — Multilingual Consent Notice Alignment
obligations.description: Publish clear itemized consent notices in specified schedule languages for digital personal data collection.

obligations.article_or_task: DPDP Sec. 8 — Security Safeguards & Breach Alerting
obligations.description: Implement anomaly detection triggers alerting the Data Protection Board within 24 hours of suspected breaches.

obligations.article_or_task: DPDP Sec. 12 — Data Principal Grievance & Erasure
obligations.description: Provide a self-service intake workflow enabling data principals to review, update, or purge personal data.
Perform annual comprehensive assessments evaluating ePHI exposure risks in model prompts and agent memories.
Enforce least-privilege role-based access control restricting medical record databases to verified clinical agents.
Log and cryptographically sign every query and prompt response containing protected health information.
Filter patient names, medical record numbers, and dates from prompts before forwarding to non-HIPAA certified endpoints.
Deploy regex tokenization to replace 16-digit card numbers with random surrogate tokens before context ingestion.
Ensure AI services operate outside the Cardholder Data Environment (CDE) boundary or adhere to PCI scope controls.
Enable automated logging for all financial transaction flows processed or routed by automated assistants.
